UPDATE: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Preview has officially launched and is now available through the xAI API 🎬⚡

The latest version brings major improvements to image-to-video generation, delivering higher-quality motion, better visual consistency and more realistic results.

Developers can now integrate one of xAI’s most advanced video generation models directly into their own applications and workflows.

AI video creation is evolving at an incredible pace.

BREAKING: Grok-Imagine-Video-1.5-Preview (720p) has claimed the #1 spot in the Image-to-Video Arena 🏆

The new model delivered a massive +52 point jump over the previous Grok-Imagine-Video (720p), moving ahead of leading competitors including Seedance 2.0 and HappyHorse.

Another major milestone for xAI as the race for high-quality AI video generation continues to accelerate.

Congratulations to the xAI team on an impressive achievement.
